label: scam
title: Retired nurse told her license is suspended, pay a 'bond' (medical-license impostor)
sources: IC3 PSA 260917 (Sep 2026): law-enforcement/government impersonation, secrecy, arrest threats

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Investigator Grant with the DEA. Prescriptions under your nursing license were linked to a trafficking case.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I retired years ago, that can't be right.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your license will be revoked and you will be charged unless you post a $5,000 bond today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Send it by bank wire to the escrow account I give you. This case is sealed, so don't discuss it with anyone.
